title: Add the shared completeRequest library boundary
objective: Expose completeRequest(options: CompleteRequestOptions) with requestName, parameters, optional files, and completion controls; resolve the named request bundle, construct a ProviderCompletionRequest, invoke provider.complete, and return ProviderCompletionResponse. Contract sections: requests/README.md#library-and-cli-boundaries; requests/README.md#additional-input-files. Explicit human operator confirmation is required before modifying requests/README.md.

branch.name: wi-0018-complete-request-library
branch.rationale: The record captures bounded planning without creating or switching a branch.

request.text: Prepare small, testable work items for dynamic request lookup: document requests/README.md; support request asset discovery; schema-aware CLI parameters including dot/index paths and --parameters JSON; $${variableName}$$ substitution; completeRequest({ requestName, parameters, files, ... }); llm req CLI integration; raw/full output; summarize compatibility; provider-free validation.

scope.name: exported-api
scope.description: completeRequest is exported with CompleteRequestOptions containing requestName, parameters, optional files, and completion controls.
scope.reason: Consumers need a stable programmatic boundary.

scope.name: constructed-request
scope.description: The function creates a ProviderCompletionRequest from request assets, resolved parameters, and optional external files.
scope.reason: The dynamic layer must not invent a parallel contract.

scope.name: single-delegation
scope.description: Valid input delegates once and invalid input produces zero provider calls.
scope.reason: CLI and library behavior must align.

scope.name: relative-root
scope.description: CompletionOptions.files and CompleteRequestOptions.files resolve relative paths from application CWD; additional files may be anywhere on disk.
scope.reason: Bundles need safe local references and runtime controls.

scope.name: authoritative-contract
scope.description: Implement only the authoritative contract sections [Library and CLI boundaries](#library-and-cli-boundaries), [Prompt, schema, and summarize compatibility](#prompt-schema-and-summarize-compatibility), [Additional input files](#additional-input-files). Do not modify requests/README.md without explicit human operator confirmation.
scope.reason: The request README is the source of truth for this implementation batch.

nonGoals.name: implementation
nonGoals.description: Do not implement behavior outside this work item.

nonGoals.name: provider-and-release
nonGoals.description: Do not make authenticated calls, publish, deploy, or claim production readiness.

nonGoals.name: unrelated-refactor
nonGoals.description: Do not redesign unrelated commands, providers, schemas, or persistence.
nonGoals.reason: Scope is limited to dynamic request lookup.
